cards.subtitle: Deterministic AIGC Short-Drama & Commercial Audiovisual Mastering pipeline evaluation (extracting visual optical-flow velocity peaks to trigger frame-exact MMAudio/FoleyCrafter V2A contact foley, applying -12 dB sidechain BGM ducking under active dialogue, and enforcing EBU R128 -14.0 LUFS / -1.0 dBTP true-peak mastering so amortized per-episode cost c_av(u) = c_0 / (1 + u) reaches 0.5000 at u = 1.0, locking C_active / C_foley = 1.0000x across all 17 mastering stages u in [0.000, 1.000] with 0/17 violated) versus naive unaligned post-dubbing & flat BGM overlay (which causes 300ms+ foley drift and masks spoken dialogue, inflating manual DAW re-edit spend by 1 + u to 1.2500x at S4, 1.5000x at S8, and 2.0000x at S16 across 16/17 stages) and 64-band loudness quadrature.
